description:
Unrefereed mathematical candidate with analytic proofs and exact formula/example checks. A positive invertible d-state Markov four-cycle has two flattening ranks d squared and a sharp crossed-rank lower bound d(d+1)/2. This excludes mixtures of at most floor(d/2) general Markov components sharing one tree topology, and extends through observable quartet marginals. A separate stationary homogeneous reversible triangle theorem covers d at least 3 and binary nonuniform stationary frequencies, with a complete binary-symmetric exception and closure analysis.

Known JC/CFN special cases and standard rank, rerooting and SVD tools are credited. Internal coordinated AI-assisted checking is not external specialist peer review, independent reproduction, formal verification, a priority certificate or an awarded REF rating. Finite rational and symbolic checks support formulas; universal statements rest on the written proofs. Original prose/data/records are CC0-1.0; original code is MIT. Scholarly creator: Anonymous. Maintainer and publisher: Ian Pitchford.
title: Sharp rank bounds and all-parameter tree–network separation
